items.comment:
feat(prompts): in-cluster agentregistry with versioned, fail-closed prompt resolution

- infra/kubernetes/prompt-registry: Pod Security restricted, digest-pinned
  Postgres for the registry (the chart's bundled Postgres violates restricted
  and hardcodes its password); values-ewallet-prompts.yaml selects it and pins
  the server digest. Installed as release prompt-registry in ewallet-prompts.
- ops/llm_agent/prompt_registry.py resolves <agent>-system at an explicit
  version, verifies the Git manifest sha256, refuses unknown, unpublished or
  tampered versions and falls back to the pinned Git copy only when allowed
  and recorded; renders the systemMessageFrom ConfigMap with version identity.
- registry_catalog publish --all-prompt-versions publishes all 12 versions.
Evidence: kind and GKE publish 17/17 readback PASS, v1/v2 retrieval, outage
fallback, persistence; production drift-specialist ConfigMap equals registry
v2 and the running agent reports prompt_revision drift-specialist/v2.
items.msg: feat(prompts): in-cluster agentregistry with versioned, fail-closed

items.comment:
fix(ci): run the RAG ingestion test suite in rag-pipeline CI

Run 6 of edai2-cd-rag-pipeline executed only the 11 test_phase_c tests of
rag-pipeline (through validate_rag_pipeline.sh, outside JUnit); the 49
ingestion, retriever and chunk-lookup tests, including the release change,
now run in the locked rag-ingestion environment with JUnit reports.
Also adds the read-only Batch D proposal (docs/edai2).
items.msg: fix(ci): run the RAG ingestion test suite in rag-pipeline CI

items.comment:
test(rag): keep the CD smoke contract consistent with the corpus manifest

jenkins/cd/rag-pipeline.contract.json must name the manifest's corpus and
embedding revisions, dimensions and the chunk count the pinned chunker
produces, so a corpus change cannot leave the CD verifier on stale values.
